[Section] Translating Data
[source_id=16] The training set provided by BIBREF0 is not very large, so it was interesting to find a way to augment the training set. A possible method is to simply translate the datasets into other languages, leaving the labels intact. Since the present study focuses on Spanish tweets, all tweets from the English datasets were translated into Spanish. This new set of “Spanish” data was then added to our original training set. Again, the machine translation platform Apertium BIBREF5 was used for the translation of the datasets.
